correctness.rationale: Fresh species reconstruction confirms the EGF and asymptotic. The finite monounary classification says either there are no sources (permutations) or all sources have one common positive height h. A rooted attached tree with all leaves exactly h below its root satisfies T_0=z and T_h=z(exp(T_{h−1})−1); a cycle vertex may carry an arbitrary set of T_{h−1}-trees, giving D_h=z exp(T_{h−1}) and F_h=SET(CYC(D_h))=1/(1−D_h). Subtracting the shared permutation class makes the height strata disjoint. Independent coefficient recomputation reproduced 1,4,27,232,2285,25716,324583,4571904,71321769,1225291780. For h=1 the unique dominant positive pole solves \(\rho e^\rho=1\) with residue 1/(1+ρ). On |z|≤0.58 all h≥2 satisfy \(|z\exp(T_{h-1}(z))|\le 0.58\exp(0.58(e^{0.58}-1))<1\) uniformly, so their coefficient total is \(O(n\,0.58^{-n})=o(\rho^{-n})\).
